notes: Sections: every class's work is sorted into sections like Homework, Tests & quizzes, Labs and Projects the moment it arrives, using your grade categories when a class has them. Agent mode sorts the ones the names don't give away.

Agent mode can read an assignment's details, sort your work, restyle ATLAS, rename tabs and change fonts and colors for you. Settings always keeps the usual look so you can undo it.
Agent mode has a fair daily allowance, so the free AI stays available for everyone.
